ledger.title: Piute Pass redemption

detail.author: dayhiker_deb

extraction.quote_span: Only a few snow patches left near the top and you can walk around all of them

detail.quote: Only a few snow patches left near the top and you can walk around all of them
detail.text: Went back to Piute on the 26th and made it this time! Only a few snow patches left near the top and you can walk around all of them. The crossing that stopped me in June is ankle deep now. So happy. Thank you to everyone who posted conditions here, this forum got me over my first pass.

extraction.quote_span: the snow got continuous and we only had trail runners

detail.quote: the snow got continuous and we only had trail runners
detail.text: Tried Piute Pass on Monday with my sister. We turned around at Piute Lake because the snow got continuous and we only had trail runners. A nice man with an ice axe said the top was fine but we did not feel good about it. The creek at the first crossing was over my knees.

ledger.title: Piute Pass 6/5

detail.author: meadowfire_m

extraction.quote_span: Snow starts just past Loch Leven, continuous to the pass, but it is the gentle kind, spikes in the morning and bare boots after lunch

detail.quote: Snow starts just past Loch Leven, continuous to the pass, but it is the gentle kind, spikes in the morning and bare boots after lunch
detail.text: Piute 6/5. Snow starts just past Loch Leven, continuous to the pass, but it is the gentle kind, spikes in the morning and bare boots after lunch. Humphreys Basin is a sea of white. North Fork crossings all have snow bridges still, watch the thin ones near the lake.
